note: City of Elkader campground in the shaded 3-acre city park near the Turkey River, beside the pool and museums; the river walk leads downtown. About 60 unassigned RV sites share 26 electric posts and 15 water connections (four faucets each), so not every site has its own hookups. The RV dump is across High St, north of the pool parking lot. --Claude
summary: All stored values confirmed from the city's page (modified 2026-04-20): $40 water/electric nightly (weekly $190, monthly $450), FCFS with no reservations, Apr 1 (weather permitting) - Nov 1, 50-amp, ~60 RV sites, showers, dump. Note trimmed of field facts. Stays not waterfront.
flags: WATERFRONT (confirms not waterfront): on imagery the Turkey River runs along the west side of town; the campground's shaded loop (RVs visible) sits 110-200 m east of the east bank, with High St and a row of buildings (the museums/depot) between. No site is on or in view of the river.
PHONE: Google Maps gives 563-245-9098 for 'Elkader City Campground'; the city's own page gives 563-245-2098 (stored). Kept the city's number.
WEBSITE OK: elkader-iowa.com/attractions/elkader-city-park/ is the city's live page (Google still links an old /City_Hall/City-Park.html path).

LONG-STAY: weekly and monthly rates are posted beside the nightly rate; the campground is FCFS with no assigned spots, so the share sold nightly cannot be measured. Local campground, so the private long-stay tests do not apply; noted for completeness.
